Trigger You Cast a Spell not modified by a jailbreak effect.

Requirements Your gear is overclocked.

You're an expert in testing the cyber defenses of tech gear and defending against incoming attacks, and you know how to use excess magic energy to troubleshoot your tech when these defenses are inevitably breached. You target tech creatures or items of a number up to the rank of the triggering spell that are within 100 feet of you. You reduce the glitching condition of the targets by half the triggering spell's rank (minimum 1). For the next minute, affected targets roll flat checks to recover from the glitching condition twice and use the higher result; this is a fortune effect.
